market_name: Will 11 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether 2y and 10y yields are actually falling and whether the move coincides with any macro headline (jobless claims, bank stress) rather than idiosyncratic market noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs fed funds futures (ZQ/SOFR) to confirm a genuine dovish repricing rather than a curve-steepening supply story.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether the prediction-market move persisted or mean-reverted; a reversal invalidates the leak thesis.
time_plan.6h: Look for confirmation across risk assets (credit spreads, VIX) consistent with a stress-driven easing narrative.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate net TLT return vs expectation; log whether the extreme-cut probability shift had any durable rate-market footprint.

predictions.reasoning: An 11-cut (275bps) scenario in 2026 is a deep-easing / recession or financial-stress tail. A sharp rise in the implied probability of such extreme easing would imply the market is pricing a dramatically lower fed funds path, which pulls down the front end and, via expectations, long yields — bullish long-duration Treasuries. TLT is the most direct liquid proxy for a dovish repricing of the Fed path.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether equities are selling off on the same catalyst that would drive extreme-easing bets; absence of a shared catalyst weakens the link.
time_plan.1h: Monitor VIX and credit (HYG/LQD) for stress confirmation versus a benign 'Fed put' rally.
time_plan.2h: Determine whether the equity tape is trading risk-off (recession read) or risk-on (liquidity read).
time_plan.6h: Reassess direction; if no stress materializes, treat the signal as noise.
time_plan.12h: Record net SPY return and whether the extreme-cut repricing carried any equity information.

predictions.reasoning: 11 cuts in a year is historically associated with crisis easing. The equity reaction is genuinely ambiguous: aggressive Fed support is a tailwind, but the underlying recession/stress cause is a headwind. Direction is therefore mixed and the net 12h move is likely small unless an actual stress catalyst is present.

evidence_used: Market strike of 11 cuts implies ~275bps of 2026 easing, an extreme deep-easing/recession tail
Deep-easing scenarios historically coincide with lower yields and elevated equity/credit stress
TLT and SPY are the most liquid proxies for Fed-path and risk sentiment repricing
uncertainty_notes: 11 cuts is a very low-probability tail; its implied probability is tiny and noisy, so moves may be illiquid artifacts
The prediction market is thinly traded and may not lead public markets at all
Equity direction is fundamentally ambiguous under aggressive easing

llm_justification.summary: The market prices an extreme 11-cut (275bps) Fed easing path for 2026, essentially a recession/crisis tail. A sharp rise in its implied probability would most cleanly map to a dovish rate repricing — bullish long-duration Treasuries (TLT up) — while equities (SPY) are directionally ambiguous because the cause (stress) offsets the support (easing). Both mappings are low-confidence and well below the 700bps tradable threshold over 12h; this is a weak, noisy signal.
key_assumptions: A probability move in this market reflects genuine shifts in expected Fed easing rather than thin-market noise
Deep easing expectations transmit to lower long yields
The 12h window is long enough to capture rate-market reaction
failure_modes: The 11-cut tail is so improbable that any probability shift is microscopic and uninformative
Information is already public (macro data releases) so no leak/edge exists
Equity proxy is ambiguously exposed — easing can be bullish or bearish, netting to noise
The prediction-market move reverses within the window
Long yields could rise despite front-end cuts (steepening/supply), breaking the TLT thesis
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
